signature.name: VTask.mkContinuous
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u} -> {ι : Type v} -> {E : ι → Type wE} -> {G : Type wG} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [(i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (E i)] -> [(i : ι) → NormedSpace 𝕜 (E i)] -> [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 G] -> [Fintype ι] -> (f : MultilinearMap 𝕜 E G) -> (C : ℝ) -> (H : ∀ (m : (i : ι) → E i), ‖f m‖ ≤ C * ∏ i, ‖m i‖) -> ContinuousMultilinearMap 𝕜 E G

conventions.statement: When C < 0, the constructor still accepts the bound proof H and produces a valid ContinuousMultilinearMap; the operator norm satisfies ‖f.mkContinuous C H‖ ≤ max C 0, which equals 0.
conventions.note: No domain restriction on C; junk-value behaviour is to fall back to the max C 0 estimate.

conventions.statement: The underlying function of f.mkContinuous C H is definitionally equal to f; evaluation at any input tuple gives the same result as f.
conventions.note: This is a coercion convention: the continuous wrapper does not change values.
